title: Twin Cities Metro Parcels (7 Counties)
description: Parcel records for the 7-county Twin Cities metro on one schema: address, owner as published, land/building/total value, taxes, use class, home style, finished sq ft, year built, units, last sale date and value.
why: One schema across seven counties, from the Metropolitan Council's regional parcel dataset, so a search for 'homes built before 1950 in Ramsey County with a sale since 2024' is one input.
useCases: Investors screening the whole metro by value, age and use
Contractors targeting a housing vintage by city
Analysts comparing counties on one schema

builtBefore.title: Built before year
builtBefore.description: Only parcels built before this year.

minValue.title: Minimum total value (USD)
minValue.description: Only parcels at or above this value.

limits: Refreshed by the Metropolitan Council on its own schedule (quarterly or so), not daily.
